title: More Global Administrators than the tenant needs

excludeAccounts.text: Emergency access accounts to leave out of the count, by name or with * and ? wildcards

maxGlobalAdmins.text: Global Administrators above which the risk outweighs the convenience

messages.businessImpact: Global Administrator can do anything in the tenant, including removing the evidence. Every additional holder is another account whose compromise ends the argument.
messages.technicalDetail: Microsoft's guidance is to keep the number small, using role-specific administrators for day to day work.
remediation: Move day to day work to Intune Administrator, Security Administrator or a custom role.
Keep emergency access accounts, and list them in the exclusions so they stop appearing here.
Make the remaining assignments eligible rather than permanent where Privileged Identity Management is licensed.
messages.cannotSee: Which accounts are emergency access accounts. They are named in the excludeAccounts override for this tenant, so a tenant that has not set one has its break-glass accounts counted here.
